# Monthly IC Memo — 2026-09

Session SESSION_MONTHLY_IC · 2026-09-05 · Aldrich (JUDGE), for the IC
Scope: first monthly IC. The packet aggregates inception-to-date (fund start 2026-07-11), so this memo reviews the full record, not a one-month slice.

## Posture

Both books remain fully in cash for a second consecutive month. GLOBAL and INDO each report **cash 100.0%, deployment 0.0%**, governor **NONE**, max drawdown **0.0%**, no open theses, no orders, no fills. The fund has run its full gauntlet for roughly two months and has yet to deploy a single dollar or rupiah. That is the central fact of this memo: the pipeline is, today, a zero-throughput filter.

## Returns vs benchmark

Not applicable in the ordinary sense — with no positions there is no portfolio return to attribute and the attribution/factor/sector blocks are empty. Book performance is cash-yield accrual only, and the IC reads "returns" this month as the **opportunity cost of the cash posture**, not a realized number. The more decision-useful evidence is in the kill ledger below.
